method: Corrected dedup telemetry transcribed from findings/02; inherited/resumed JSONL events are deduplicated by stable turn_id/call_id before aggregation.

dedup_correction.denominator: 952 deduplicated completed turns from 472 thread artifacts across four named projects

journals.classification_denominator: 550 classified events; physical records are retained separately because journals include non-lifecycle and historical-compensation rows

limitations: Summed task-hours can overlap and are not wall-clock elapsed time.
Journal actor strings are heterogeneous; telemetry cannot prove route adherence for every item.
The selected session evidence is deliberately metadata-only, so it supports cited incidents but not transcript-level causal attribution.
One-shot counts are directional signals, not a formal pass@1 metric.
